name: Radicchio
description: Tight purple-white heads, distinctly bitter — grilled, or shredded raw.

tcm.note: Bitter greens are cooling and heat-clearing.

ayurveda.note: Tikta rasa is shita and pitta-clearing.

unani.note: In the hindiba family, which is barid-yabis and well documented in Unani as a liver cooler.
